name: attendance_letter_1
description: First letter about a pupil's attendance (stage: Letter 1).
subject: Attendance - {pupil_name}
body: We are writing because we are concerned about {first_name}'s attendance.
{first_name}'s attendance from {period} is {attendance_pct}%. {first_name} has missed {sessions_missed} sessions (half-days), {unauthorised} of them unauthorised.
Regular attendance matters: pupils who attend well achieve more and stay safe. Below 90% is classed as persistent absence.
If something is making it hard for {first_name} to come to school, please contact us so we can help. We will keep a close eye on attendance over the coming weeks.

placeholders.pupil_name: The pupil's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.details: Meeting date, the agreed target and any extra note
